_ghi_chu: EN-ALL GĐ 7 — mẫu câu tiếng Anh cho Hôm nay · Ba lá · Nhịp · Thẻ ngày · Tuần này · Hôm nay của hai người · Đọc tiếp · Bản đồ 5 mảng (ban biên tập, chờ người bản xứ duyệt).
nhip.luu_y: A numerology rhythm for self-reflection — it suggests themes, it does not predict what will happen.
nhip.ba_la.cach_chon: The three cards are picked from your date of birth and today's date — the same person on the same day always gets the same three cards; tomorrow brings three new ones. The Tarot card is always read upright. This is a prompt for self-reflection, not a forecast.

nhip.tom_lai.lich.tot: By the traditional calendar, today is a good day, though big matters are best timed to a good hour; ordinary tasks can go ahead
nhip.tom_lai.lich.thuong_truc: By the traditional calendar, today is an ordinary day, suited to manageable tasks
nhip.tom_lai.lich.thuong: By the traditional calendar, today is an ordinary day, better for familiar tasks than for starting something big
